notes: TurboCut is a vanilla TypeScript app (no React, no Tailwind), so the engine's React files are followed as conventions, not copied: hook classes, tab recipe, dialog structure, panel cards, asset naming, version scheme, docs layout, guides inside Settings. Differences on purpose: (1) builds also run for claude/** branches and publish pre-releases, because the owner tests every branch on a phone; (2) auto-pr.yml is used (added 2026-10-21 at the owner's request: every pushed branch gets one pull request, so at most main plus one working branch exists); (3) check.yml is ci.yml and runs on every push; (4) turbothemes is installed from turboengine#path:/themes (the lockfile resolves it to a codeload tarball); (5) editions, window-frame, settings-shell and android-shell are not used: TurboCut has one edition, a native-looking window, and a plain Capacitor Android shell. (6) Brought closer to the engine on 2026-10-17: pin moved to c795082, icons are inline SVG in currentColor (src/app/icons.ts, no emoji or symbol characters), the side panel is a `bt-shell`, system-fonts adopted.
